name: Centaur!
source:
It was a kingdom of centaurs ruled by the Centaur King. 
You, the son of the King and uniquely human, traveled east and west, far and wide across, in service of a land you were unlikely to ever rule. 
Then one day, a message reached you on the battlefield. The King had declared a tournament of battle by horseback. 
Whoever should win would have it all. 

You can win. The time has come for you to choose a mount... a centaur who will let you ride her to glory... 

A mythical novel ADV where all heroines are half-girl, half-horse!

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE136496.html]DLsite English[/url]]
